# OpenCode Agents

> Lean agent pack for OpenCode: 10 specialist agents, 28 on-demand skills, 18 slash
> commands. Plan, implement, review, and document without leaving the terminal.
> MIT licensed. OpenCode v1 supported; v2 installs and loads, runtime hooks not yet
> exercised.

## Install

Global (shared by every project):

```
npx agents-opencode --global
```

Project scope (preferred for agentic installation):

```
npx agents-opencode --project .
```

Keep only selected language skills:

```
npx agents-opencode --global --languages python,typescript
```

Update:

```
npx agents-opencode --update
npx agents-opencode --update --all
```

## Entry points

- Getting started: https://agnts.elkodr.com/getting-started/
- Agentic installation (hand the install to an agent): https://agnts.elkodr.com/agentic-installation/
- Agents: https://agnts.elkodr.com/agents/
- Skills matrix: https://agnts.elkodr.com/skills-matrix/
- Commands: https://agnts.elkodr.com/commands/
- Review gate: https://agnts.elkodr.com/review-gate/
- Compatibility: https://agnts.elkodr.com/compatibility/
- OpenCode v1/v2 support: https://agnts.elkodr.com/opencode-v1-v2-support/
- Troubleshooting: https://agnts.elkodr.com/troubleshooting/

## Facts

- 10 agents: orchestrator, codebase, review, docs, planner, researcher, brutal-critic,
  legal-advisor, em-advisor, blogger.
- 28 skills, loaded on demand — no context cost until a skill is invoked.
- 18 slash commands.
- Skills are host-compatible: pack agents allow host skills by default.
- `--languages` prunes unused language skills; non-language skills always remain.

## First prompt

```txt
opencode
/init
@orchestrator Build a user authentication API with JWT tokens
```

## Verification

```
ls .opencode/agents | wc -l      # 10
ls .opencode/skills | wc -l      # 28
ls .opencode/commands | wc -l    # 18
```
